subject.title: refactor: consolidate auto-reply routing regression tests

question: Should a maintainer accept this protected auto-reply test refactor after verifying that the complete case matrix preserves all prior edge-case assertions?
rationale: The protected label requires human handling, and the blocked read-only environment prevented an independent full-diff and ownership review.

options.title: Review and merge after equivalence check
options.body: Confirm the full case tables preserve every former assertion and merge if the claimed focused validation is available.

options.title: Request reviewable validation artifact
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript or linked Testbox artifact showing the isolated suite and coverage comparison before deciding.

recommendation.title: Review and merge after equivalence check
recommendation.body: Confirm the full case tables preserve every former assertion and merge if the claimed focused validation is available.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history and ownership evidence could not be read in the review environment.
